messages:
Sam: Quick poll — breakfast tomorrow? Bagels or burritos? Vote with emoji: :bagel: = bagels, :burrito: = burritos
Priya: Bagels please! +1 for everything bagel :raised_hands:
Jamal: Burritos. add hot sauce pls
Lina: Bagels but only if there's schmear options
Morgan: Burritos from El Camino would be amazing
Sam: adding a quick poll link: https://polls.redwood.internal/1768501234 (react to that msg)
Priya: also, who needs vegetarian or gluten-free options? @Lina
Lina: GF bagel works for me :+1:
order-bot: Poll created — react to this message with :bagel: or :burrito:. Poll ends in 2h.
Jamal: reacted :burrito:
Morgan: reacted :burrito:
Priya: reacted :bagel:
Sam: quick tally from reactions — burritos 2, bagels 1 so far. Looks like burritos might win :tada:
Lina: ok burritos fine. anyone want eggs on the side? :egg:
Jamal: me please
Sam: I'll place the order around 8:45am. If you want to add something reply here. :calendar:
Morgan: can we get extra hot sauce packets pls :hot_pepper:
Priya: adding a note: one plain bagel for me (GF). Thanks Sam! :coffee:
